messages:
hannah: We're scheduling a mini-cohort canary for model-routing in the 04:00 UTC window. Plan: open flag "mini_cohort_cutover" to 0.15% for 12m (smoke), then 2.5% for 18m, then 8% if all gates pass. Pin to model=v3.2-econ for canary. @miguel @ira pls ack.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: model-routing @ 04:00 UTC. Ramp: 0.15% -> 2.5% (12m) -> 8% (conditional). Health pings 20s. Auto-hold on 3 failed pings or errorRate>0.6%.

miguel: ack. Proposed rollback thresholds: errorRate>0.5% for 3m => rollback; p95 delta>+200ms for 5m => hold; sudden p99 jump >+350ms => immediate hold. Also recommend run short smoke test (5 reqs) after each step.

ira: I'll add release note: "mini_cohort_cutover warmup; v3.2-econ pinned; rollback gates: err>0.5% / p95>+200ms / 3 failed pings". Who's oncall?

ops-anne: I'll be backup. Pre-warm caches on canary for 7m. Set rollback drain=30s to limit tail. Tag deploy meta: window=early-morning.

hannah: runbook CLI for docs:
```
redwood flag set mini_cohort_cutover --cohort 0.0015 --stages smoke,soak --pin model=v3.2-econ --meta "deploy:6509991111;owner=hannah;window:early-morning"
```

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6509991135. Health pings streaming to #eng-releases-canary.

miguel: first 6m metrics: errorRate 0.09%, p95 +85ms, p99 +140ms. smoke tests passed. Proceed to 2.5% in 6m unless anyone objects.

ira: good. I'll push the short-customer blurb after the second stage passes.

miguel: watching dashboards now. If gates trip I'll flip flag off and pin traffic back to stable-route, will post rollback decision and open incident thread.
